name: rac-menengai
description: Rotaract Club of Menengai — Service Above Self. Multi-page React + Vite + TypeScript site: About, Projects, Awards, Leadership, News, Membership, Contact.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir .prerender && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src api scripts content index.html vercel.json vite.config.ts
